title: Dental PPO Plans Pediatric Essential Health Benefit
content:
**Who receives it.** On an individual exchange enrollment under the Dental PPO Plans, a covered person who has not reached the pediatric essential-health-benefit age limit birthday on the date of service receives the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment.

**Effect on the annual maximum.** The treatment overrides the annual maximum: no annual maximum applies to that person's lines and nothing is posted to the annual maximum used.

**Out-of-pocket maximum.** The person's in-network cost sharing accumulates toward the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum: the plan's one-child maximum when one child of the subscriber is enrolled on individual exchange enrollments, and the plan's two-or-more maximum, combined across the children, when two or more are enrolled. Once the applicable maximum is reached for the benefit period, in-network covered lines are paid at the full allowance with member responsibility 0.00; the line that crosses the maximum pays the allowance minus the cost sharing still remaining.

**What does not count.** Out-of-network cost sharing and services the plan does not cover never count toward the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum. The treatment ends with the line whose date of service is on or after the age-limit birthday. The deductible, coinsurance, waiting periods, frequency limits and service classes of the plan still apply.

### Crossing the maximum (hypothetical, one child, maximum 500.00, 470.00 already accumulated)
An in-network line with an allowance of 120.00 and cost sharing of 60.00 under the plan's coinsurance: only 30.00 of cost sharing remains, so the member pays 30.00 and the plan pays 120.00 less 30.00, which is 90.00. A later in-network line in the same benefit period is paid at its full allowance.
